name: @pipeworx/mcp-us-drought-monitor

tools.name: us_drought_national
tools.description: Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor drought-severity statistics for the nation: percent of area or percent of population in categories None, D0 (abnormally dry) through D4 (exceptional drought). Categories are cumulative (D1+ means D1 through D4 combined, i.e. 'at least moderate drought'). Covers the contiguous 48 states (conus), the contiguous states plus Alaska/Hawaii/Puerto Rico (total), or both at once (us). Published weekly — map valid every Tuesday, released the following Thursday. Omit dates for the latest available map.

area.description: conus = contiguous 48 states only. total = contiguous states plus Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico. us = both rows at once. Default conus.

measure.description: 'area' = percent of land area in each category (default). 'population' = percent of the area's population in each category.

start_date.description: Earliest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

end_date.description: Latest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

tools.name: us_drought_state
tools.description: Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor drought-severity statistics for one U.S. state or territory: percent of area or percent of population in categories None, D0 (abnormally dry) through D4 (exceptional drought). Categories are cumulative (D1+ means D1 through D4 combined). Published weekly — map valid every Tuesday, released the following Thursday. Omit dates for the latest available map.

state.description: State or territory name, two-letter postal abbreviation, or two-digit FIPS code, e.g. 'Texas', 'TX', or '48'.

measure.description: 'area' = percent of land area in each category (default). 'population' = percent of the state's population in each category.

start_date.description: Earliest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

end_date.description: Latest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

tools.name: us_drought_county
tools.description: Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor drought-severity statistics for one U.S. county: percent of county area or percent of county population in categories None, D0 (abnormally dry) through D4 (exceptional drought). Categories are cumulative (D1+ means D1 through D4 combined). Published weekly — map valid every Tuesday, released the following Thursday. Match by state plus county name (e.g. state 'TX', county 'Travis'), or pass the county's 5-digit FIPS code directly. Omit dates for the latest available map.

state.description: State name or two-letter postal abbreviation, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'. Required unless fips is given.

county.description: County name, with or without the word 'County' (e.g. 'Travis' or 'Travis County'). Required unless fips is given.

fips.description: The county's 5-digit FIPS code. Use instead of state+county when known.

measure.description: 'area' = percent of the county's land area in each category (default). 'population' = percent of the county's population in each category.

start_date.description: Earliest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

end_date.description: Latest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-us-drought-monitor forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the us-drought-monitor pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
